digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics analyzers and dev bootstrap
propositions: The dev bootstrap paths (Makefile install and install-unlocked) must explicitly name the metrics extra to pin the intent that analyzer toolchains are installed, independent of CI-testing rationales.
The two non-Python analyzers (scc and jscpd) cannot be installed via Python extras and require documented install steps: brew install scc and npm install -g jscpd.
Absence of scc or jscpd must degrade gracefully to Unavailable in rebar metrics output rather than causing hard failures.
A fresh venv provisioned by make install must successfully import lizard 1.23.0, and uv lock --check must pass with zero lock drift after edits.
docs/local-dev-env.md must document scc and jscpd install commands and explicitly state both are optional.
